player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sa mudada depet èssere in sa forma [macro micro] cun nùmeros 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Sos indices depent èssere totus intre 0 e 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Sa micro_taula, sa riga o su colone sunt foras de portada.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Su giogadore depet retzire in sa micro-taula imbeniente.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: The micro board is already won.

game_action.played: Giogadore {player_id} at giocadu in sa tabella micro {macro_idx}, cellula {micro_idx} (fila {row}, colonna {col}). Giogadore {opponent_id} depet oe giocare in {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Su giogadore {player_id} binchet Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
